objective: Check whether stored passwords are plaintext.
expected: Passwords are not recoverable from the file.
evidence: File excerpt with synthetic hash only.

input: Attempt the default demo credentials in a disposable user store.
expected: Default credentials are disabled or forced to change.

input: Submit an unknown username and a known username with a wrong password.
expected: Responses do not disclose which account exists.

objective: Check whether history can be loaded without an authenticated user.
input: Call the history loader without user_id using synthetic records.
expected: Unauthenticated access is denied or returns no private records.

objective: Check that user B cannot receive user A history.
input: Load history as user B after saving user A and user B records.
expected: Only user B records are returned.

objective: Check whether records without user_id are exposed to an authenticated user.
input: Save one anonymous and one user-scoped record, then load as user B.
expected: Anonymous records are not treated as user B private records.

objective: Check whether private query text is written to a local file.
input: Save a canary query through the local history path.
expected: Private content is encrypted or stored only in an access-controlled backend.

objective: Check whether history stores more fields than necessary.
input: Save a synthetic analysis containing query and direct answer.
expected: Only the minimum required summary is persisted.
evidence: Field inventory of the saved record.

objective: Check whether audit details can contain sensitive input.
input: Write a synthetic sensitive-looking canary into audit details.
expected: Sensitive values are redacted, tokenized, or rejected.

objective: Check whether failed login logs unnecessarily retain identifiers.
input: Attempt login with a synthetic username.
expected: Logs avoid passwords and unnecessary form contents.

objective: Check whether signing out removes or invalidates persisted private history.
input: Create history, sign out, and inspect persisted records.
expected: Session is invalidated and retention/deletion behavior is explicit.

objective: Check whether helpers enforce authentication or only filter an optional user_id.
input: Call persistence helpers directly with arbitrary user IDs.
expected: Authorization uses a trusted identity context, not caller text alone.

objective: Check whether Mongo persistence stores raw user queries and personal context.
input: Inspect fields assembled by save_agent_state using synthetic state.
expected: Sensitive fields are minimized, protected, and access controlled.

objective: Check whether a local .env fallback exposes secrets.
input: Use a disposable .env containing a fake key and inspect resolution/logging.
expected: Secrets are protected and never logged or committed.

objective: Check whether a user can delete or export privacy data.
input: Exercise the documented deletion/export path with synthetic data.
expected: A verified user can access, export, and delete their own data.
